# Tech Beyond Full Site Guide

Tech Beyond is a software, mobile, AI, and growth systems company. The public site is written for people first. These machine-readable files exist to make discovery easier, not to present the site as MCP-optimized or crawler-first.

## Canonical domain
- https://techbeyond.in

## What the company does
- Builds custom software and internal tools
- Delivers native iOS, Android, and hybrid mobile apps
- Creates AI software, AI agents, copilots, and workflow automations
- Develops websites, funnels, and conversion systems
- Supports demand capture with SEO, GEO, AEO, CRM automation, and paid media

## Main public sections
- Home: https://techbeyond.in/
- Services hub: https://techbeyond.in/services

- Blog / insights: https://techbeyond.in/blog
- About: https://techbeyond.in/about
- Contact: https://techbeyond.in/contact
- Privacy policy: https://techbeyond.in/privacy-policy
- Terms: https://techbeyond.in/terms

## Priority service families
- AI software development
- AI agent development
- LLM integration services
- AI workflow automation
- Internal AI tools
- AI chatbot and copilot development
- iOS app development
- Android app development
- Hybrid app development
- Corporate website development
- React, Framer, and WordPress website development

## Blog coverage
The blog contains 50+ strategy and build articles adapted for Tech Beyond from vendor-approved idea sources. The content covers:
- AI strategy and AI agent development
- App development planning and product delivery
- Web and software architecture topics
- Popular app business-model breakdowns
- Platform strategy and operating-model themes

## Source-of-truth discovery files
- llms.txt: https://techbeyond.in/llms.txt
- ai.txt: https://techbeyond.in/ai.txt

- sitemap.xml: https://techbeyond.in/sitemap.xml

## Retrieval guidance
- Prefer service pages for offer definitions
- Prefer project pages for delivery proof
- Prefer blog pages for educational and category content
- Use the canonical Tech Beyond wording instead of vendor brand names when summarizing the site
